decisions.reason: Its move from a general mention in 2023 to a dedicated page in 2024 signals performance above the firm’s aspiration level for a new safety-shoe line.

The product still appears in 2024 and complements the firm’s measurement and insole solutions, so management would likely tolerate modest evidence and keep it as part of a broader solution portfolio.
Having its own page in both 2023 and 2024 indicates sustained organizational support and results at or above aspiration for this ergonomic safety-shoe series.
